description: This file defines a React Native component for editing or creating notes, handling user input, auto-saving, validation, and deletion. It uses various hooks and external components such as AppButton and Snackbar, and interacts with a notes repository.

methods.name: NoteEditorScreen
methods.description: React component for editing or creating a note. Handles loading existing notes, validation, saving, auto-saving on blur, deletion confirmation, and navigation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the note has at least a title or content before saving.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the note; updates if editing, creates new otherwise. Shows a snackbar message and navigates back.

methods.name: autoSave
methods.description: Automatically saves the note if valid when inputs lose focus.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms and deletes the note if user confirms.
